**Case 1 \- Prompt \- Show me all retail assets of India**

![][image1]

API 1 (For Subheader Details)   

This API is called 5 times \- once for each datapoint for parallel load experience (GEOGRAPHY, DEMOGRAPHICS, PLANNING, STORE\_NETWORK, COMPETITORS \- refer to datapoints enum below API signature)

**Location Aggregates**

**\*\*Endpoint\*\***: \`POST /location-aggregate/v1/location-aggregates\`

**\*\*Request Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

locationType: 'INDIA' | 'STATE' | 'CITY' | 'VILLAGE'; // Required

locationId?: string; // Optional, required for STATE/CITY/VILLAGE

datapoints?: string\[\]; // Optional

categories?: string\[\]; // Optional

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Response Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

code: string;

message: string;

data: StateApiResponse | GeographyLocationData | CompetitorsLocationData

| DemographicsLocationData | PlanningLocationData | StoreNetworkLocationData;

requestId?: string;

inTime?: string;

outTime?: string;

latency?: number;

}

\`\`\`

ENUMERATIONS

public enum Category {

    CUSTOMERS,

    BUILDINGS,

    POIS,

    STOREENETWORK,

    SUPPLYCHAIN,

    COMPETITORS

}

Example Request:

{

  "code": "200",

  "message": "Success",

  "data": {

    "locationType": “INDIA",

    "locationId": "",

    "categories": \[

      "CUSTOMERS",

      "BUILDINGS",

      "POIS",

      "STORENETWORK",

  "outTime": "2025-12-12T20:08:18.1112344",

  "latency": 3

}

API 3 (For State/UT Clusters)

**Store Cluster**

**\*\*Endpoint\*\***: \`POST /store/v1/store-cluster\`

**\*\*Request Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

// For INDIA

{

locationType: 'INDIA'

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Response Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

code: string;

message: string;

data: {

locationType: 'INDIA';

locationName: string;

locationId?: string;

subType?: string;

clusterData: Array\<{

name: string;

id: string;

lat: number;

lon: number;

storeCount: number;

categoryCounts?: { \[category: string\]: number };

}\>;

};

requestId?: string;

inTime?: string;

outTime?: string;

latency?: number;

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Response Format\*\***: ZIP file (Blob) \- automatically extracted by interceptor

**\*\*Service Method\*\***: \`ApiService.getStoreClusterZipped()\`

**\*\*Validation Rules\*\***:

\- \`locationType\` must be 'INDIA' or 'STATE'

\- When \`locationType \= 'STATE'\`: \`locationId\` and \`subType\` are mandatory

\- When \`locationType \= 'INDIA'\`: \`locationId\` and \`subType\` should not be included

API 1 (For Subheader Details)   

This API is called 5 times \- once for each datapoint for parallel load experience (GEOGRAPHY, DEMOGRAPHICS, PLANNING, STORE\_NETWORK, COMPETITORS \- refer to datapoints enum below API signature) For State ID, you can refer to the mapping from Case 1

**Location Aggregates**

**\*\*Endpoint\*\***: \`POST /location-aggregate/v1/location-aggregates\`

**\*\*Request Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

locationType: 'STATE' ; // Required

locationId?: string; // Optional, required for STATE/CITY/VILLAGE

datapoints?: string\[\]; // Optional

categories?: string\[\]; // Optional

}

**\*\*Response Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

code: string;

| DemographicsLocationData | PlanningLocationData | StoreNetworkLocationData;

requestId?: string;

inTime?: string;

outTime?: string;

latency?: number;

}

\`\`\`

**Enum Values of categories in request: (If no enum is sent in request, no category breakdown will be given in response)**

***  CUSTOMERS***("CUSTOMERS"),

    ***STORENETWORK***("STORENETWORK"),

    ***SUPPLYCHAIN***("SUPPLYCHAIN"),

    ***COMPETITORS***("COMPETITORS");

**Enum Values of datapoints in request: (If no enum is sent in request, all values will be given in response)**

***  GEOGRAPHY***("GEOGRAPHY"),

    ***DEMOGRAPHICS***("DEMOGRAPHICS"),

    ***PLANNING***("PLANNING"),

    ***STORE\_NETWORK***("STORE\_NETWORK"),

    ***COMPETITORS***("COMPETITORS”);

API 2 (For State/UT Aggregates)   

This API is called twice. Once to retrieve the City list of a state, second time to retrieve Town-Village list. (Toggle subtype)

**Store Cluster**

**\*\*Endpoint\*\***: \`POST /store/v1/store-cluster\`

**\*\*Request Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

// For INDIA

{

locationType: 'INDIA'

}

// For STATE

{

locationType: 'STATE';

locationId: string; // Required (e.g., "MH", "GJ")

subType: 'CITY' | 'VILLAGE'; // Required

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Response Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

code: string;

message: string;

data: {

locationType: 'STATE' ;

locationName: string;

locationId?: string;

subType?: string;

clusterData: Array\<{

name: string;

id: string;

lat: number;

lon: number;

storeCount: number;

categoryCounts?: { \[category: string\]: number };

}\>;

};

requestId?: string;

inTime?: string;

outTime?: string;

latency?: number;

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Response Format\*\***: ZIP file (Blob) \- automatically extracted by interceptor

**\*\*Service Method\*\***: \`ApiService.getStoreClusterZipped()\`

**\*\*Validation Rules\*\***:

\- \`locationType\` must be 'INDIA' or 'STATE'

\- When \`locationType \= 'STATE'\`: \`locationId\` and \`subType\` are mandatory

\- When \`locationType \= 'INDIA'\`: \`locationId\` and \`subType\` should not be included

API 3 (For State/UT Clusters)

This API is used to get the retail assets state/city/village wise

**Retail Assets**

**\*\*Endpoint\*\***: \`POST /store-list/v1/retail-assets\`

**\*\*Request Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

locationType: 'STATE' | 'CITY' | 'VILLAGE'; // Required

locationId: string; // Required (e.g., "MH" for state)

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Raw Response Signature\*\*** (before zip extraction):

\`\`\`typescript

{

code: string; // "200"

message: string; // "Success"

data: string; // Base64-encoded zip file

requestId?: string;

inTime?: string; // ISO timestamp

outTime?: string; // ISO timestamp

latency?: number; // milliseconds

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Extracted Response Signature\*\*** (after zip extraction):

The extracted JSON can be one of the following structures:

\`\`\`typescript

// Structure 1: Direct Array

Array\<StoreItem\>

// Structure 2: Stores Property

{

stores: Array\<StoreItem\>

}

// Structure 3: Nested Data

{

data: {

stores: Array\<StoreItem\>

}

}

// Structure 4: Deeply Nested

{

data: {

data: {

stores: Array\<StoreItem\>

}

}

}

// Structure 5: Data Array

{

data: Array\<StoreItem\>

}

// Structure 6: Cluster Data (backward compatibility)

{

clusterData: Array\<StoreItem\>

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*StoreItem Signature\*\***:

\`\`\`typescript

{

// Core Identification

storeName?: string;

name?: string; // Alternative name field

storeId?: string;

id?: string; // Alternative ID field

// Location (Required)

lat: number; // Latitude

lon: number; // Longitude

address?: string; // Format: "State \- City \- Village \- Store ID"

// Category Information

assetCategory?: string; // e.g., "Dark Store", "Retail Store", "SCM"

storeFormat?: string; // e.g., "DIGITAL", "PHYSICAL"

siteCategory?: string; // e.g., "DARK STORE", "RETAIL STORE"

subCategory?: string;

// Geographic Details

stateCode?: string; // e.g., "MH", "GJ"

stateName?: string; // e.g., "Maharashtra"

cityCode?: string;

cityname?: string;

villageRjid?: string;

villagename?: string;

// Store Metrics (Optional)

area?: number;

dailyFootfall?: number;

daily\_footfall?: number; // Alternative field name

dailyOrders?: number;

daily\_orders?: number; // Alternative field name

// Supply Chain

supplyType?: string;

supply\_type?: string; // Alternative field name

// Internal Fields (added during processing)

\_stateCode?: string;

\_stateName?: string;

}

\`\`\`

**\*\*Response Format\*\***: JSON with base64-encoded zip in \`data\` field \- automatically extracted by interceptor

**\*\*Service Method\*\***: \`ApiService.getRetailAssets()\`

**\*\*Zip Extraction\*\***: HTTP interceptor automatically extracts JSON file from zip archive
